questions.question_bn: Mass 8 kg speed 6 m/s, stationary mass 16 kg-এ লেগে একসঙ্গে চলে। final speed কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 8। External impulse negligible; momentum (8)·6=((8)+2×(8))v⇒v=2। kinetic energy conserved নয়।

questions.question_bn: Force-time graph triangular: base 9 s, peak 6 N। particle mass 3 kg। speed change magnitude কত?
